$comment: The one declaration of the Bun used by CI and Workers Builds.
An exact npm pin: a release (1.4.3) or a dated canary with its build sha.
"canary" selects GitHub's rolling canary instead, as it did from 2026-10-06
until 1.4.3 shipped bun check on 2026-10-10; it bypasses the publication-age
gate and two fresh installs can resolve different commits.
The shared .github/install-bun.sh verifies the registry sha512 and the
binary's version (or a canary's sha) before installing it.
Do not add packageManager to package.json: Workers Builds cannot resolve
dated canaries there. Both build paths use this file and the shared installer.
